title: PromptFrenzy Directory Tool Entry
description: Schema for a single AI tool entry under tools/ or seed/

url.description: Canonical URL of the tool's homepage

description.description: One-sentence factual description, no superlatives or marketing copy

pricing_detail.description: Specific pricing beyond the tier, e.g. 'Free tier watermarked; Pro $19/mo for 500 credits'. Optional but encouraged — it makes the listing page far more useful.

key_features.description: 2-6 short factual capability bullets, one per string. Optional but encouraged.

works_with.description: Tools, platforms, or models this integrates with, e.g. ['chatgpt', 'figma', 'vs code']. Optional but encouraged — powers cross-linking.

platforms.description: Where the tool runs / how it's accessed. Optional but encouraged.

badge_url.description: URL where our verifier will look for the badge. Required for tools/, omitted for seed/.

seeded.description: True for editor-curated seed entries (no badge required)

submitted_by.description: GitHub username of the submitter (auto-filled from PR author)

sample_use_case.description: 2-3 sentence paragraph describing a realistic use case. Auto-generated at submit time by promptfrenzy.com/api/directory/submit (Gemini 2.5 Flash via AIMLAPI). Optional — pages render fine without it.

removed_at.description: When the entry was moved to removed/. Set only when status is 'removed'.

removal_reason.description: Why the entry was removed. Only 'badge-failure' (30 days in failed, per README) is a punitive mark — the others record a cooperative, editorial, or housekeeping delisting and carry no implication of gaming. 'duplicate' means the same product is already listed under another entry, which stays live.
